# certera.ink

> AI diploma and certificate generator with tamper-proof verification on the Hedera blockchain.

certera.ink lets schools, course providers and HR teams design branded, animated diplomas and certificates with an AI chat assistant that extracts branding from a website or document. Issued certificates can be verified by anyone through a blockchain-backed verification page.

## Links

- [Home](https://www.certera.ink/)
- [Demo](https://www.certera.ink/demo)
- [Certificate API for course providers](https://www.certera.ink/developers): issue signed, verifiable certificates with one request or a course-completed webhook
- [Verify a certificate](https://www.certera.ink/verify)
